question.en: Which form of the main verb is ALWAYS used in the Passive Voice across all tenses?
question.hi: सभी कालों (tenses) में पैसिव वॉइस (Passive Voice) में मुख्य क्रिया का कौन सा रूप हमेशा प्रयोग किया जाता है?

text.en: V1 (Base form)
text.hi: V1 (मूल रूप)

text.en: V2 (Past form)
text.hi: V2 (भूतकाल रूप)

text.en: V3 (Past Participle form)
text.hi: V3 (पास्ट पार्टिसिपल रूप)

text.en: V4 (Present Participle / -ing form)
text.hi: V4 (प्रेजेंट पार्टिसिपल / -ing रूप)

explanation.en: Passive voice construction universally requires the V3 (Past Participle) form of the main verb combined with an appropriate auxiliary verb.
explanation.hi: पैसिव वॉइस की संरचना में सार्वभौमिक रूप से मुख्य क्रिया के V3 (पास्ट पार्टिसिपल) रूप की आवश्यकता होती है, जिसके साथ उपयुक्त सहायक क्रिया जुड़ी होती है।

question.en: Does the tense change when converting a sentence from Active Voice to Passive Voice?
question.hi: क्या एक्टिव वॉइस (Active Voice) से पैसिव वॉइस (Passive Voice) में बदलते समय काल (tense) बदलता है?

text.en: Yes, always
text.hi: हाँ, हमेशा

text.en: No, never
text.hi: नहीं, कभी नहीं

text.en: Only in future tense
text.hi: केवल भविष्य काल में

text.en: Only in past tense
text.hi: केवल भूतकाल में

explanation.en: The basic tense of the sentence never changes during voice transformation; only the structural representation changes.
explanation.hi: वॉइस परिवर्तन के दौरान वाक्य का मूल काल कभी नहीं बदलता है, केवल संरचनात्मक रूप बदलता है।

question.en: Which type of verbs can be converted into Passive Voice?
question.hi: किस प्रकार की क्रियाओं (verbs) को पैसिव वॉइस में बदला जा सकता है?

text.en: Intransitive verbs only
text.hi: केवल अकर्मक क्रियाएँ (Intransitive verbs)

text.en: Transitive verbs only
text.hi: केवल सकर्मक क्रियाएँ (Transitive verbs)

text.en: All verbs
text.hi: सभी क्रियाएँ

text.en: Linking verbs only
text.hi: केवल लिंकिंग वर्ब्स

explanation.en: Only Transitive Verbs (verbs that take an object) can be converted into Passive Voice because the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
explanation.hi: केवल सकर्मक क्रियाओं (Transitive Verbs) को ही पैसिव वॉइस में बदला जा सकता है क्योंकि एक्टिव वाक्य का कर्म (object) पैसिव वाक्य का कर्ता (subject) बनता है।

question.en: How many tenses out of the total 12 English tenses CANNOT be converted into Passive Voice?
question.hi: कुल 12 अंग्रेजी कालों में से कितने कालों को पैसिव वॉइस में नहीं बदला जा सकता है?

text.en: Two
text.hi: दो

text.en: Three
text.hi: तीन

text.en: Four
text.hi: चार

text.en: Five
text.hi: पाँच

explanation.en: Four tenses cannot be converted into Passive Voice: 3 Perfect Continuous tenses (Present, Past, Future) and the Future Continuous tense.
explanation.hi: चार कालों को पैसिव वॉइस में नहीं बदला जा सकता है: 3 परफेक्ट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस (वर्तमान, भूत, भविष्य) और फ्यूचर कंटीन्यूअस टेंस।

question.en: What additional word is used in Continuous tenses (Present/Past) when converting to Passive Voice?
question.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलते समय कंटीन्यूअस टेंस (वर्तमान/भूत) में किस अतिरिक्त शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है?

text.en: been
text.hi: been

text.en: being
text.hi: being

text.en: having
text.hi: having

text.en: to be
text.hi: to be

explanation.en: Continuous tenses take 'being' (is/am/are/was/were + being + V3) in their passive voice structures.
explanation.hi: कंटीन्यूअस टेंस अपनी पैसिव वॉइस संरचनाओं में 'being' (is/am/are/was/were + being + V3) का उपयोग करते हैं।

question.en: What additional word is used in Perfect tenses (Present/Past/Future) when converting to Passive Voice?
question.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलते समय परफेक्ट टेंस (वर्तमान/भूत/भविष्य) में किस अतिरिक्त शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है?

text.en: being
text.hi: being

text.en: been
text.hi: been

text.en: be
text.hi: be

text.en: done
text.hi: done

explanation.en: Perfect tenses take 'been' (has/have/had + been + V3) in their passive voice forms.
explanation.hi: परफेक्ट टेंस अपने पैसिव वॉइस रूपों में 'been' (has/have/had + been + V3) का उपयोग करते हैं।

question.en: In a standard active to passive conversion, the subject of the active sentence becomes the _______ of the passive sentence.
question.hi: एक मानक एक्टिव से पैसिव रूपांतरण में, एक्टिव वाक्य का कर्ता (subject) पैसिव वाक्य का _______ बन जाता है।

text.en: Object
text.hi: कर्म (Object)

text.en: Verb
text.hi: क्रिया (Verb)

text.en: Adverb
text.hi: क्रियाविशेषण (Adverb)

text.en: Auxiliary
text.hi: सहायक क्रिया (Auxiliary)

explanation.en: The subject and object interchange positions. The active subject becomes the agent/object preceded by 'by' (or another appropriate preposition) in the passive voice.
explanation.hi: कर्ता और कर्म अपनी स्थिति आपस में बदल लेते हैं। एक्टिव का कर्ता पैसिव वॉइस में 'by' (या अन्य उपयुक्त पूर्वसर्ग) के साथ एजेंट/कर्म बन जाता है।

question.en: Which preposition is normally used before the agent in a standard Passive Voice sentence?
question.hi: मानक पैसिव वॉइस वाक्य में एजेंट से पहले सामान्यतः किस प्रीपोज़िशन (preposition) का प्रयोग किया जाता है?

text.en: with
text.hi: with

text.en: by
text.hi: by

text.en: at
text.hi: at

text.en: to
text.hi: to

explanation.en: The preposition 'by' is standardly used before the doer (agent) in passive voice, though specific verbs take other fixed prepositions.
explanation.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में करने वाले (agent) से पहले सामान्यतः 'by' प्रीपोज़िशन का उपयोग किया जाता है, हालांकि कुछ विशेष क्रियाओं के साथ अन्य निश्चित प्रीपोज़िशन आते हैं।

question.en: What is the passive form of 'She writes a letter'?
question.hi: 'She writes a letter' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: A letter was written by her.
text.hi: A letter was written by her.

text.en: A letter is written by her.
text.hi: A letter is written by her.

text.en: A letter has been written by her.
text.hi: A letter has been written by her.

text.en: A letter is being written by her.
text.hi: A letter is being written by her.

explanation.en: 'She writes a letter' is in Present Simple tense. Its passive is Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + Subject -> 'A letter is written by her.'
explanation.hi: 'She writes a letter' प्रेजेंट सिंपल टेंस में है। इसका पैसिव Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + Subject होता है -> 'A letter is written by her.'

question.en: What is the passive form of 'The dog chased the cat'?
question.hi: 'The dog chased the cat' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: The cat is chased by the dog.
text.hi: The cat is chased by the dog.

text.en: The cat was chased by the dog.
text.hi: The cat was chased by the dog.

text.en: The cat has been chased by the dog.
text.hi: The cat has been chased by the dog.

text.en: The cat chased the dog.
text.hi: The cat chased the dog.

explanation.en: 'Chased' is past tense (V2). Past simple passive uses was/were + V3. Thus, 'The cat was chased by the dog.'
explanation.hi: 'Chased' भूतकाल (V2) है। पास्ट सिंपल पैसिव में was/were + V3 का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'The cat was chased by the dog.'

question.en: Choose the correct passive voice for: 'Open the door.'
question.hi: 'Open the door.' वाक्य का सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनें।

text.en: The door is opened.
text.hi: The door is opened.

text.en: Let the door be opened.
text.hi: Let the door be opened.

text.en: The door should open.
text.hi: The door should open.

text.en: Let open the door.
text.hi: Let open the door.

explanation.en: Imperative sentences expressing a command are converted using the formula: Let + object + be + V3. Hence, 'Let the door be opened.'
explanation.hi: आदेश व्यक्त करने वाले आज्ञासूचक (Imperative) वाक्यों को 'Let + object + be + V3' सूत्र का उपयोग करके बदला जाता है। अतः 'Let the door be opened.'

question.en: Convert into Passive Voice: 'Who wrote this book?'
question.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'Who wrote this book?'

text.en: By whom was this book written?
text.hi: By whom was this book written?

text.en: Who was written this book by?
text.hi: Who was written this book by?

text.en: Whom was this book written by?
text.hi: Whom was this book written by?

text.en: This book was written by who?
text.hi: This book was written by who?

explanation.en: Interrogative sentences starting with 'Who' change 'Who' to 'By whom' followed by the auxiliary verb corresponding to the tense. 'wrote' is past tense, so 'By whom was this book written?'
explanation.hi: 'Who' से शुरू होने वाले प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'Who' को 'By whom' में बदला जाता है, जिसके बाद काल के अनुसार सहायक क्रिया आती है। 'wrote' भूतकाल है, अतः 'By whom was this book written?'

question.en: What is the correct passive form of: 'They are building a new bridge.'
question.hi: 'They are building a new bridge.' का सही पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: A new bridge is built by them.
text.hi: A new bridge is built by them.

text.en: A new bridge is being built by them.
text.hi: A new bridge is being built by them.

text.en: A new bridge has been built by them.
text.hi: A new bridge has been built by them.

text.en: A new bridge was being built by them.
text.hi: A new bridge was being built by them.

explanation.en: Present Continuous tense takes 'is/am/are + being + V3'. Therefore, 'A new bridge is being built by them.'
explanation.hi: प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस में 'is/am/are + being + V3' का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए, 'A new bridge is being built by them.'

question.en: Select the correct passive form of: 'People speak English all over the world.'
question.hi: 'People speak English all over the world.' का सही पैसिव रूप चुनें।

text.en: English is spoken all over the world by people.
text.hi: English is spoken all over the world by people.

text.en: English is spoken all over the world.
text.hi: English is spoken all over the world.

text.en: English was spoken all over the world.
text.hi: English was spoken all over the world.

text.en: English speaks all over the world.
text.hi: English speaks all over the world.

explanation.en: When the subject is an indefinite or vague pronoun/noun like 'people', 'someone', or 'police', it is generally omitted in the passive voice unless necessary.
explanation.hi: जब कर्ता एक अनिश्चित या अस्पष्ट सर्वनाम/संज्ञा जैसे 'people', 'someone', या 'police' हो, तो पैसिव वॉइस में आमतौर पर उसे छोड़ दिया जाता है जब तक कि आवश्यक न हो।

question.en: Identify the correct passive voice for: 'Please help me.'
question.hi: 'Please help me.' के लिए सही पैसिव वॉइस पहचानें।

text.en: You are ordered to help me.
text.hi: You are ordered to help me.

text.en: You are requested to help me.
text.hi: You are requested to help me.

text.en: Let me be helped.
text.hi: Let me be helped.

text.en: You are advised to help me.
text.hi: You are advised to help me.

explanation.en: Sentences starting with 'Please' indicate a polite request, so they are converted using 'You are requested to...'
explanation.hi: 'Please' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य एक विनम्र अनुरोध दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए उन्हें 'You are requested to...' का उपयोग करके बदला जाता है।

question.en: What is the passive form of: 'The teacher will punish the naughty boy.'
question.hi: 'The teacher will punish the naughty boy.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: The naughty boy would be punished by the teacher.
text.hi: The naughty boy would be punished by the teacher.

text.en: The naughty boy will be punished by the teacher.
text.hi: The naughty boy will be punished by the teacher.

text.en: The naughty boy is punished by the teacher.
text.hi: The naughty boy is punished by the teacher.

text.en: The naughty boy has been punished by the teacher.
text.hi: The naughty boy has been punished by the teacher.

explanation.en: Future Simple tense uses 'will/shall + be + V3' in the passive voice. The modal auxiliary 'will' remains 'will', not 'would'.
explanation.hi: फ्यूचर सिंपल टेंस पैसिव वॉइस में 'will/shall + be + V3' का उपयोग करता है। मॉडल सहायक क्रिया 'will' ही रहती है, 'would' नहीं।

question.en: Choose the correct passive voice for: 'Has she completed her work?'
question.hi: 'Has she completed her work?' का सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनें।

text.en: Has her work completed by her?
text.hi: Has her work completed by her?

text.en: Has her work been completed by her?
text.hi: Has her work been completed by her?

text.en: Have her work been completed by her?
text.hi: Have her work been completed by her?

text.en: Was her work completed by her?
text.hi: Was her work completed by her?

explanation.en: Present Perfect interrogative sentences use Has/Have + object + been + V3. 'Her work' is singular, so it takes 'Has'.
explanation.hi: प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य Has/Have + object + been + V3 का उपयोग करते हैं। 'Her work' एकवचन है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'Has' आएगा।

question.en: Select the correct passive form: 'The police caught the thief.'
question.hi: सही पैसिव रूप चुनें: 'The police caught the thief.'

text.en: The thief is caught by the police.
text.hi: The thief is caught by the police.

text.en: The thief was caught by the police.
text.hi: The thief was caught by the police.

text.en: The thief has been caught by the police.
text.hi: The thief has been caught by the police.

text.en: The thief had been caught by the police.
text.hi: The thief had been caught by the police.

explanation.en: 'Caught' is V2 (Past Simple), which takes 'was/were + V3' in passive voice.
explanation.hi: 'Caught' V2 (पास्ट सिंपल) है, जो पैसिव वॉइस में 'was/were + V3' लेता है।

question.en: What is the passive voice of: 'Somebody has stolen my bicycle.'
question.hi: 'Somebody has stolen my bicycle.' का पैसिव वॉइस क्या है?

text.en: My bicycle has been stolen.
text.hi: My bicycle has been stolen.

text.en: My bicycle has been stolen by somebody.
text.hi: My bicycle has been stolen by somebody.

text.en: My bicycle was stolen.
text.hi: My bicycle was stolen.

text.en: My bicycle had been stolen.
text.hi: My bicycle had been stolen.

explanation.en: Indefinite pronouns like 'somebody' or 'nobody' as agents are generally dropped in the passive voice unless emphasizing the doer.
explanation.hi: एजेंट के रूप में 'somebody' या 'nobody' जैसे अनिश्चित सर्वनामों को पैसिव वॉइस में आमतौर पर हटा दिया जाता है।

question.en: Choose the correct passive form for: 'Do you know him?'
question.hi: 'Do you know him?' का सही पैसिव रूप चुनें।

text.en: Is he known by you?
text.hi: Is he known by you?

text.en: Is he known to you?
text.hi: Is he known to you?

text.en: Does he know you?
text.hi: Does he know you?

text.en: Is he known with you?
text.hi: Is he known with you?

explanation.en: The verb 'know' takes the fixed preposition 'to' instead of 'by' in the passive voice.
explanation.hi: क्रिया 'know' पैसिव वॉइस में 'by' के स्थान पर निश्चित प्रीपोज़िशन 'to' लेती है।

question.en: Identify the correct passive voice for: 'His conduct surprised me.'
question.hi: 'His conduct surprised me.' के लिए सही पैसिव वॉइस पहचानें।

text.en: I was surprised by his conduct.
text.hi: I was surprised by his conduct.

text.en: I was surprised at his conduct.
text.hi: I was surprised at his conduct.

text.en: I was surprised with his conduct.
text.hi: I was surprised with his conduct.

text.en: I was surprised in his conduct.
text.hi: I was surprised in his conduct.

explanation.en: The verb 'surprise' takes the fixed preposition 'at' (not 'by') when converted into Passive Voice.
explanation.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलते समय क्रिया 'surprise' के साथ 'by' के स्थान पर निश्चित प्रीपोज़िशन 'at' का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: What is the correct passive form of: 'This bottle contains milk.'
question.hi: 'This bottle contains milk.' का सही पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: Milk is contained by this bottle.
text.hi: Milk is contained by this bottle.

text.en: Milk is contained in this bottle.
text.hi: Milk is contained in this bottle.

text.en: Milk is contained with this bottle.
text.hi: Milk is contained with this bottle.

text.en: Milk contains in this bottle.
text.hi: Milk contains in this bottle.

explanation.en: The verb 'contain' takes the fixed preposition 'in' in the passive voice.
explanation.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में 'contain' क्रिया के साथ निश्चित प्रीपोज़िशन 'in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

question.en: Choose the correct passive voice for: 'Rose smells sweet.'
question.hi: 'Rose smells sweet.' का सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनें।

text.en: Rose is smelled sweet.
text.hi: Rose is smelled sweet.

text.en: Rose is sweet when it is smelled.
text.hi: Rose is sweet when it is smelled.

text.en: Sweet is smelled by rose.
text.hi: Sweet is smelled by rose.

text.en: Rose is being smelled sweet.
text.hi: Rose is being smelled sweet.

explanation.en: This is a quasi-passive verb (intransitive verb with an adjective complement). The correct transformation formula is: Subject + is/am/are + adjective + when + it/they + is/are + V3.
explanation.hi: यह एक अर्ध-पैसिव (quasi-passive) क्रिया है। इसे बदलने का सही सूत्र है: Subject + is/am/are + adjective + when + it/they + is/are + V3।

question.en: What is the passive form of: 'They elected him leader.'
question.hi: 'They elected him leader.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: Leader was elected him by them.
text.hi: Leader was elected him by them.

text.en: He was elected leader by them.
text.hi: He was elected leader by them.

text.en: He was elected as leader by them.
text.hi: He was elected as leader by them.

text.en: He is elected leader.
text.hi: He is elected leader.

explanation.en: In sentences with factitive verbs (elect, name, appoint, select) taking an object complement, the direct object ('him' -> 'He') becomes the subject, followed by V3 and the complement. 'As' is not used before the complement.
explanation.hi: फैक्टिटिव वर्ब्स (elect, name, appoint, select) वाले वाक्यों में मुख्य कर्म ('him' -> 'He') सब्जेक्ट बनता है, जिसके बाद V3 और फिर कॉम्प्लीमेंट आता है। कॉम्प्लीमेंट से पहले 'as' का प्रयोग नहीं होता।

question.en: Select the correct passive form for: 'It is time to shut the shop.'
question.hi: 'It is time to shut the shop.' का सही पैसिव रूप चुनें।

text.en: It is time for the shop to be shut.
text.hi: It is time for the shop to be shut.

text.en: It is time the shop was shut.
text.hi: It is time the shop was shut.

text.en: The shop is time to be shut.
text.hi: The shop is time to be shut.

text.en: It is time to be shut the shop.
text.hi: It is time to be shut the shop.

explanation.en: Sentences starting with 'It is time to + V1 + object' follow the passive pattern: It is time + for + object + to be + V3.
explanation.hi: 'It is time to + V1 + object' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य पैसिव पैटर्न का पालन करते हैं: It is time + for + object + to be + V3।

question.en: What is the passive voice of: 'Her success pleased everyone.'
question.hi: 'Her success pleased everyone.' का पैसिव वॉइस क्या है?

text.en: Everyone was pleased by her success.
text.hi: Everyone was pleased by her success.

text.en: Everyone was pleased with her success.
text.hi: Everyone was pleased with her success.

text.en: Everyone was pleased at her success.
text.hi: Everyone was pleased at her success.

text.en: Everyone were pleased with her success.
text.hi: Everyone were pleased with her success.

explanation.en: The verb 'please' takes the fixed preposition 'with' when referring to things or achievements like success.
explanation.hi: सफलता जैसी चीज़ों या उपलब्धियों के संदर्भ में क्रिया 'please' के साथ निश्चित प्रीपोज़िशन 'with' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

question.en: Choose the correct passive voice for: 'They say that honesty is the best policy.'
question.hi: 'They say that honesty is the best policy.' का सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनें।

text.en: It is said that honesty is the best policy.
text.hi: It is said that honesty is the best policy.

text.en: Honesty is said to be the best policy.
text.hi: Honesty is said to be the best policy.

text.en: Both A and B are correct.
text.hi: A और B दोनों सही हैं।

text.en: That honesty is the best policy is said by them.
text.hi: That honesty is the best policy is said by them.

explanation.en: Sentences with impersonal 'They say that...' can be correctly converted into passive voice in two standard ways: 'It is said that...' or 'Subject + is/are said to...'. Hence both A and B are correct.
explanation.hi: 'They say that...' वाले वाक्यों को दो मानक तरीकों से पैसिव में बदला जा सकता है: 'It is said that...' या 'Subject + is/are said to...'। अतः A और B दोनों सही हैं।

question.en: What is the passive form of: 'The news alarmed us.'
question.hi: 'The news alarmed us.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: We were alarmed by the news.
text.hi: We were alarmed by the news.

text.en: We were alarmed at the news.
text.hi: We were alarmed at the news.

text.en: We were alarmed with the news.
text.hi: We were alarmed with the news.

text.en: We were alarmed in the news.
text.hi: We were alarmed in the news.

explanation.en: The verb 'alarm' (along with words like shock, surprise, displease) takes the fixed preposition 'at' in the passive voice.
explanation.hi: क्रिया 'alarm' (तथा shock, surprise, displease जैसे शब्दों) के साथ पैसिव वॉइस में निश्चित प्रीपोज़िशन 'at' का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Select the correct passive form for: 'Do not beat the dog.'
question.hi: 'Do not beat the dog.' का सही पैसिव रूप चुनें।

text.en: Let the dog not be beaten.
text.hi: Let the dog not be beaten.

text.en: The dog should not beat.
text.hi: The dog should not beat.

text.en: You are ordered not to beat the dog.
text.hi: You are ordered not to beat the dog.

text.en: Both A and C are correct.
text.hi: A और C दोनों सही हैं।

explanation.en: Negative imperative sentences can be converted into passive using either 'Let + object + not + be + V3' or 'You are ordered/requested/advised not to + V1'. Both A and C are grammatically valid.
explanation.hi: नकारात्मक आज्ञासूचक वाक्यों को 'Let + object + not + be + V3' या 'You are ordered/requested/advised not to + V1' दोनों तरीकों से बदला जा सकता है। अतः A और C दोनों सही हैं।

question.en: What is the passive form of: 'We must keep our promises.'
question.hi: 'We must keep our promises.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: Our promises must keep.
text.hi: Our promises must keep.

text.en: Our promises must be kept.
text.hi: Our promises must be kept.

text.en: Our promises had to be kept.
text.hi: Our promises had to be kept.

text.en: Our promises must been kept.
text.hi: Our promises must been kept.

explanation.en: Sentences containing modal auxiliary verbs (can, could, may, might, must, should) follow the structure: Modal + be + V3. Thus, 'Our promises must be kept.'
explanation.hi: मॉडल सहायक क्रियाओं (can, could, may, might, must, should) वाले वाक्य संरचना का पालन करते हैं: Modal + be + V3। अतः 'Our promises must be kept.'
